import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None:
            return
        try:
            v = float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return
        if not np.isfinite(v):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(v, 1) if metric in ("share", "rank") or period in ("WoW", "YoY") else round(v, 2),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    for c in ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
              "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    tot_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    tot_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    tot_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly_rows = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_LY"])

    # Totals
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", tot_tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", tot_lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if len(ly_rows) > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", tot_ly, "sum(Revenue_LY) over rows with LY data")
    if tot_lw and tot_lw != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", (tot_tw - tot_lw) / tot_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if len(ly_rows) > 0 and ly_rows["Revenue_LY"].sum() != 0:
        a = ly_rows["Revenue_TW"].sum()
        b = ly_rows["Revenue_LY"].sum()
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", (a - b) / b * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100 on rows with LY data")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "LW", df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_LW)")
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if u_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", (df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True) - u_lw) / u_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if o_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", (df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True) - o_lw) / o_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # Top entities by revenue this week
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for this entity")
        share = r["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")) else (
            r["Revenue_TW"] / tot_tw * 100 if tot_tw else None)
        add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", share, "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if len(top) > 0:
        add(top.iloc[0]["Entity"], "rank", "TW", top.iloc[0].get("Rank", 1),
            "rank by Revenue_TW (1 is highest)")
    if len(top) >= 3 and tot_tw:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", top.head(3)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / tot_tw * 100,
            "sum(top 3 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # WoW percent movers
    wow = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"])
    if len(wow) > 0:
        g = wow.loc[wow["WoW_Pct"].idxmax()]
        add(g["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", g["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (largest gain)")
        d = wow.loc[wow["WoW_Pct"].idxmin()]
        if d["Entity"] != g["Entity"]:
            add(d["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", d["WoW_Pct"],
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (largest decline)")

    # WoW absolute movers
    tmp = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    if len(tmp) > 0:
        tmp["delta"] = tmp["Revenue_TW"] - tmp["Revenue_LW"]
        up = tmp.loc[tmp["delta"].idxmax()]
        add(up["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", up["Revenue_TW"],
            "Revenue_TW of the entity with the largest absolute WoW revenue gain")
        add(up["Entity"], "revenue", "LW", up["Revenue_LW"],
            "Revenue_LW of the entity with the largest absolute WoW revenue gain")
        dn = tmp.loc[tmp["delta"].idxmin()]
        add(dn["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW",
            (dn["Revenue_TW"] - dn["Revenue_LW"]) / dn["Revenue_LW"] * 100 if dn["Revenue_LW"] else None,
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (largest absolute decline)")

    # YoY movers
    yoy = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"])
    if len(yoy) > 0:
        g = yoy.loc[yoy["YoY_Pct"].idxmax()]
        add(g["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", g["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (largest gain)")
        d = yoy.loc[yoy["YoY_Pct"].idxmin()]
        if d["Entity"] != g["Entity"]:
            add(d["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", d["YoY_Pct"],
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (largest decline)")

    # Units / orders leaders
    uu = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"])
    if len(uu) > 0:
        r = uu.loc[uu["Units_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(r["Entity"], "units", "TW", r["Units_TW"], "max(Units_TW) across entities")
    oo = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"])
    if len(oo) > 0:
        r = oo.loc[oo["Orders_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(r["Entity"], "orders", "TW", r["Orders_TW"], "max(Orders_TW) across entities")

    # Smallest contributor
    if len(top) > 0:
        last = top.iloc[-1]
        add(last["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", last["Revenue_TW"],
            "Revenue_TW of the lowest ranked entity")
        add(last["Entity"], "share", "TW",
            last["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(last.get("Share_Pct")) else (
                last["Revenue_TW"] / tot_tw * 100 if tot_tw else None),
            "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100 for the lowest ranked entity")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
